description: Free. Before an agent shops on a website, get its signed Annalist check from our weekly commerce census: is it a store, does it take agent checkout (UCP or ACP) and at which MCP endpoint, which payment handlers, how many countries it ships to, and which AI agents its robots.txt blocks. Verify the signature with the key at /.well-known/annalist-key.json.
name: annalist_verify_store
title: Check a website before shopping there (free)
